## Core Services & Capabilities

2. **High-Performance Web Development**: Custom React.js web applications, Vite, HTML5/SCSS, GSAP smooth animations, sub-second page loading speeds (99+ PageSpeed).
3. **Mobile & Web Product Design**: Responsive iOS/Android app interfaces, user flow optimization, micro-interactions, and conversion-focused UX layouts.
4. **Design Systems & Component Libraries**: Reusable UI kits, typography scales, tokenized color palettes, and accessible component architectures.
